name: LFCarry Guide Evidence Smoke Tests
description: 24 synthetic claim/evidence cases and a deterministic Node.js scorer for testing AI-written gaming guides. The 8 scenario groups cover dates, game versions, prerequisites, denominators, and conflicting sources. Missing predictions stay in the scoring denominator. MIT licensed, with 0 external dependencies and 0 network calls. Independent human review and production model measurements are pending. Maintained by LFCarry.
